overview_description.description: StreamElements is the premier platform of tools and services for livestream and video production, monetization, audience engagement, influencer marketing, and brand sponsorships. The platform provides content creators with 100% free cloud-based overlays, alerts, chatbots, loyalty and affiliate programs, sponsorships, and brand-safe moderation with legendary customer service. In addition to powering millions of creators across platforms such as Twitch, YouTube, Twitter, and TikTok, StreamElements connects their massive audiences to brands through creator-driven performance marketing campaigns at scale.
